title: Long-conversation drill: Holiday coverage in accounts payable
context: You will hear an accounts payable team at a freight company in Richmond planning who will work over the holidays.

segments.speaker: Farah, team lead
segments.text: Okay, I've got the holiday calendar up. Finance wants at least two of us in the office every working day from December twenty-second to January second, because of the year-end close. So let's see who's away when.

segments.speaker: Kevin, AP clerk
segments.text: I already booked flights to Ho Chi Minh City. I leave on the twentieth and I'm back on the fifth, so I'm out for the whole period. Sorry, I booked them back in August.

segments.speaker: Farah, team lead
segments.text: No, that's fine, it was approved months ago. Priscilla?

segments.speaker: Priscilla, AP clerk
segments.text: I was hoping to take Christmas week off, so the twenty-second to the twenty-sixth. But I'm flexible after that. I could work the twenty-ninth through the second.

segments.speaker: Dmitri, AP analyst
segments.text: I'm happy to work Christmas week. The only thing is, I celebrate Orthodox Christmas on January seventh, so I'd like the sixth and seventh off. That's after the close, so it shouldn't be a problem.

segments.speaker: Farah, team lead
segments.text: Okay, so Christmas week, it's Dmitri and me, I guess. Except I was going to take the twenty-third off for my daughter's recital.

segments.speaker: Priscilla, AP clerk
segments.text: I could come in that one day, the twenty-third, if it helps. My in-laws don't arrive until the evening.

segments.speaker: Farah, team lead
segments.text: Are you sure? That would be great. I'll owe you one.

segments.speaker: Dmitri, AP analyst
segments.text: Wait, what about the twenty-ninth onward? Priscilla's in, I'm in. Do you need to be there too, Farah?

segments.speaker: Farah, team lead
segments.text: Somebody has to sign off on the year-end accruals by the thirty-first, and that's me. So I'll be in on the twenty-ninth, thirtieth and thirty-first at least. Dmitri, if you wanted the second off for a long weekend, Priscilla and I could cover it.

segments.speaker: Dmitri, AP analyst
segments.text: Thanks, but I'd rather work the second and keep the sixth and seventh like I planned.

segments.speaker: Kevin, AP clerk
segments.text: Can I suggest something? I'll have my laptop with me. With the time difference, I could clear the vendor payment queue overnight, so you're not starting every morning with a backlog.

segments.speaker: Farah, team lead
segments.text: That's generous, Kevin, but you're on vacation. Let's keep that as a last resort. I'll text you only if we're really falling behind.

segments.speaker: Priscilla, AP clerk
segments.text: So just to confirm, I'm off the twenty-second, twenty-fourth and twenty-sixth, but in on the twenty-third?

segments.speaker: Farah, team lead
segments.text: Right, and the twenty-fifth is a stat holiday anyway. I'll update the calendar and send it to finance this afternoon.

questions.prompt: Who will be in the office on December twenty-third?

options.text: Farah and Dmitri
options.whyVi: Farah nghỉ ngày 23 để dự buổi biểu diễn của con gái.

options.text: Farah and Priscilla
options.whyVi: Farah nghỉ ngày 23, nên không thể là cặp này.

options.text: Priscilla and Dmitri
options.whyVi: Đúng: Dmitri làm cả tuần Giáng sinh, và Priscilla đi làm riêng ngày 23 để thay Farah.

options.text: Dmitri and Kevin, working remotely
options.whyVi: Kevin chỉ đề nghị làm từ xa, nhưng Farah chỉ xem đó là phương án cuối cùng.

questions.evidence: I could come in that one day, the twenty-third, if it helps.
questions.explanationVi: Phải nối nhiều lượt nói: Dmitri làm tuần Giáng sinh, Farah muốn nghỉ ngày 23, rồi Priscilla nhận làm thay riêng ngày đó.

questions.prompt: Why does Farah need to work from the twenty-ninth to the thirty-first?

options.text: Dmitri asked to take those days off.
options.whyVi: Dmitri muốn nghỉ ngày 6 và 7 tháng 1, không phải những ngày này.

options.text: She is the person who must approve certain year-end figures.
options.whyVi: Đúng: cô phải ký duyệt các khoản dồn tích cuối năm trước ngày 31.

options.text: Priscilla can only work part of that period.
options.whyVi: Ngược lại: Priscilla có thể làm từ ngày 29 đến ngày 2.

options.text: Finance requires three people in the office on those days.
options.whyVi: Sai: bộ phận tài chính yêu cầu ít nhất HAI người.

questions.evidence: Somebody has to sign off on the year-end accruals by the thirty-first, and that's me.
questions.explanationVi: 'sign off on the year-end accruals' được diễn đạt lại thành 'approve certain year-end figures'. Câu này trả lời câu hỏi Dmitri đặt ra trước đó.

questions.prompt: What does Dmitri decide about January second?

options.text: He will take it off to have a long weekend.
options.whyVi: Ngược lại: anh từ chối lời đề nghị nghỉ ngày 2.

options.text: He will work it and still take his planned days off later.
options.whyVi: Đúng: anh đi làm ngày 2 và giữ ngày 6, 7 như kế hoạch.

options.text: He will swap it with Priscilla for the twenty-third.
options.whyVi: Không có chuyện đổi ngày giữa Dmitri và Priscilla.

options.text: He will take it off instead of January sixth and seventh.
options.whyVi: Farah có gợi ý cho anh nghỉ ngày 2, nhưng anh chọn giữ ngày 6 và 7.

questions.evidence: I'd rather work the second and keep the sixth and seventh like I planned.
questions.explanationVi: Farah đề nghị cho Dmitri nghỉ ngày 2, nhưng anh nói 'I'd rather work the second and keep the sixth and seventh'. Cần nghe đến phản hồi cuối của anh.

questions.prompt: How does Farah react to Kevin's offer?

options.text: She accepts it and asks him to handle payments every night.
options.whyVi: Ngược lại: cô không giao việc hằng đêm cho Kevin.

options.text: She rejects it because of data security rules.
options.whyVi: Không ai nhắc đến quy định bảo mật.

options.text: She is annoyed that he booked his trip during the close.
options.whyVi: Ngược lại: cô nói chuyến đi đã được duyệt từ lâu và 'that's fine'.

options.text: She appreciates it but will only use it if necessary.
options.whyVi: Đúng: cô khen 'generous' nhưng chỉ nhắn nếu thật sự bị tồn đọng.

questions.evidence: That's generous, Kevin, but you're on vacation. Let's keep that as a last resort.
questions.explanationVi: 'generous' cho thấy cô cảm kích; 'last resort' = chỉ dùng khi không còn cách nào khác, được diễn đạt lại thành 'only... if necessary'.

questions.prompt: Which days will Priscilla be away from work during Christmas week?

options.text: Every day of that week except the twenty-third
options.whyVi: Đúng: nghỉ ngày 22, 24, 26, và 25 là ngày lễ; chỉ đi làm ngày 23.

options.text: The whole week, including the twenty-third
options.whyVi: Đây là kế hoạch ban đầu, nhưng sau đó cô nhận đi làm ngày 23.

options.text: Only the twenty-fifth, because it is a holiday
options.whyVi: Sai: cô nghỉ cả ngày 22, 24 và 26.

options.text: From the twenty-ninth to January second
options.whyVi: Ngược lại: đây là những ngày cô đi làm.

questions.evidence: I'm off the twenty-second, twenty-fourth and twenty-sixth, but in on the twenty-third?
questions.explanationVi: Kế hoạch của Priscilla thay đổi trong cuộc trò chuyện. Câu xác nhận cuối cùng cho biết cô chỉ đi làm ngày 23; ngày 25 là ngày lễ.

vocabulary.definition: the accounting work done to finish and check a company's records for the year
vocabulary.example: We need two people in the office during the year-end close.

vocabulary.definition: do someone's work while they are away
vocabulary.example: Priscilla and I could cover the second.
Farah has to sign off on the accruals.

vocabulary.definition: income or expenses recorded before money is actually paid or received
vocabulary.example: The year-end accruals must be approved by the thirty-first.

vocabulary.definition: work that has built up and not yet been done
vocabulary.example: Nobody wants to start the morning with a backlog.

vocabulary.definition: something you do only when every other option has failed
vocabulary.example: Let's keep that as a last resort.

vocabulary.definition: a statutory holiday, an official paid day off set by law
vocabulary.example: The twenty-fifth is a stat holiday.

review.notes: Rebuilt the full coverage calendar (two staff every working day Dec 22-Jan 2 is met) and solved all 5 items; keys correct, Q5 consistent with BC stat holidays (Dec 25 only; Boxing Day is not a BC stat). 4 voices, 4/5 long_conversation. Q2 option A trap changed wrong_speaker -> wrong_detail (Dmitri did ask for days off, just different ones).
